description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty plugin function 'html_options' used to generate HTML select options. It defines the main function 'smarty_function_html_options' along with helper functions for outputting option tags and option groups, and handles parameters such as options, values, selected, and HTML attributes.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Template
classes.description: A class representing Smarty's internal template object, used as a parameter in the main function.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options
methods.description: Generates a HTML select element with options, options can be supplied as an array or an associative array. Handles attributes, selected options, and optgroups.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optoutput
methods.description: Creates individual option tags, handles escaping, selection, and object conversion.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_options_optgroup
methods.description: Creates an option group (<optgroup>) with nested options.
